messages:
tess_ops: quick follow-up from todays all-hands infra update about GPUs and autoscale. thanks for the clear overview! :clap:
tess_ops: quick Qs: (1) which SKUs go to Dedicated vs Hosted burst pools? (2) whats the expected cold-start impact for short spikes?

ravi_infra: short answers: Dedicated = H100/A100 primarily. Hosted high-tier uses same, lower-cost tiers use T4/RTX for embeddings and some autoscale fallbacks. Were keeping a small reserve of cheaper cards to handle bursty, low-cost workloads.

ana_sre: typo correction: ana_sre here :) re cold starts: warm pools (1-3 per-AZ) should cover most spikes; cold_start_rate target <3% post-rollout. For extreme surges well route to preemptible capacity or stitch down to quantized model variants to keep p99 reasonable.

jamie_product: can we add a short line in the signup flow and reservation UI about phased region availability? want to avoid surprise when APAC is delayed.

ravi_infra: yes, console will show "estimated availability" and well add a brief note in signup copy. exact dates pushed to status page as inventory is confirmed.

notify-bot: [deploy] autoscaler v2 canary scheduled for 2026-08-01T02:00Z -> 10% Dedicated clusters. Monitor: autoscale_events, p99_latency, cold_start_rate.

ana_sre: sample config teams can use to simulate: ```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_warm_instances: 2
  burst_capacity_pct: 25
  cold_start_grace_ms: 120
```

tess_ops: useful. last: any pricing changes for commits or burst billing?

ravi_infra: committed pricing unchanged. burst/preemptible usage billed separately; console will show estimated burst costs from historical traffic.

maya_ceo: please produce a one-pager + FAQ by Friday so support/growth have consistent comms. call out region ETAs and autoscale behavior.

ravi_infra: will deliver by Friday EOD and post here.

tess_ops: thanks team 44d
